explanation.owner_view:
Great news—your site photos confirm that the slab casting stage is complete, which justifies releasing the next tranche of your loan. The verified value of the work completed so far stands at ₹14,83,072 against your cumulative disbursed amount of ₹12,14,337.

However, we want to highlight an important financial update regarding your remaining construction costs:
- Sanctioned Loan Amount: ₹25,00,000
- Estimated Total Construction Cost: ₹29,66,144.51
- Quoted BOQ Total: ₹28,45,140 (Fair Market Value for quoted scope: ₹2,73,7220)
- Cost to Complete Remaining Work: ₹14,83,072
- Remaining Loan Funds Gap (Cost-to-Complete Gap): ₹-1,97,409
- Total Sanction Gap: ₹-4,66,144.51

Because the remaining loan funds will fall short by ₹1,97,409 to finish the build at expected market costs, we strongly recommend reviewing your project scope or planning self-funding for the shortfall now.

To help optimize costs, here are specific clarification and negotiation questions to discuss with your contractor:
1. Binding Wire (Item 4.1): Can you clarify the gauge and material standard (e.g., 16/18 SWG GI or annealed wire)?
2. Teak Wood Frame (Item 8.1): Could you provide a detailed timber specification and breakdown for the seasoned teak door frame?
3. Anti-Termite Treatment (Item 2.5): Please provide a detailed technical specification or supplier quotation per IS 6313.
4. Electrical & Distribution Board (Items 9.2, 9.3): Could you confirm the specific model series for Anchor Roma modular switches/sockets and Havells single-phase DB way-capacity?
5. Plumbing Fixtures & Tank (Items 10.3, 10.4, 10.5): Please clarify model numbers and warranty terms for Hindware EWCs, Cera wash basins/pillar taps, and Sintex 1000L tank accessories.
6. Paints & MS Work (Items 11.3, 12.1, 12.2): Can you specify the brand/grade of synthetic enamel paint for MS work, model/gauge details for the Nirali kitchen sink, and section thickness for the 4'x7' MS main gate?
